thread:
Ava C (CS): Quick sync: we need to finalize the SLA report for Nimbus before renewal. Their legal wants uptime numbers, p95 latency by route, and credit calc.

Jon K (AM): Agree. Onboarding shows ~60% traffic on Dedicated vs Hosted — want to know how that affects latency SLO mapping.

Priya O (SRE): We can provide per-route p50/p95 and outage windows. Current hosted avg uptime 99.992% last 30d. Dedicated pool had a 45m maintenance on 2026-03-02 -> credit eligibility?

Ava C (CS): They asked specifically how credits are calculated. Can someone paste the formula we use for uptime credits in the SLA doc?

Priya O (SRE): ```
# simplified credit calc
credit = max(0, floor((SLO_target - actual_uptime)/SLO_target * monthly_fee))
``` 

Jon K (AM): We should normalize for scheduled maintenance in private/dedicated clause — that 45m was scheduled but not communicated to Nimbus properly, so it's a renewal risk.

Priya O (SRE): It was scheduled but our oncall ticket INC-2345 didn't get their AM. I'll escalate to Eng to add a rollout reminder to the CS playbook.

Martin L (Renewals): If we offer a one-time service credit equal to 5% of their monthly invoice, that should cover it. Need legal sign-off; also include latency regressions — they saw p95 jump to 1.8s during a model rollout last month.

Ava C (CS): Action items: Priya -> pull per-route latency histograms + incident logs; Jon -> draft credit calc explanation; Martin -> propose credit amount for AM; I'll schedule a 30-min customer walkthrough next Tue. @cs-bot will send calendar invite?

cs-bot: Calendar invite created: "SLA alignment - Nimbus" Tue 10:00am PT. Invite sent to nimbus-team@example.com

Jon K (AM): Also add an appendix showing mitigations: KV-cache, auto-burst, fallback model variants. Helps technical reviewers.

Priya O (SRE): I'll attach config snippets and the rollout policy excerpt. Recommend a table: metric | target | actual | window | credit_eligible (Y/N).

Ava C (CS): Perfect. Aim to send draft by EOD Fri. @maria_legal can you quick-check the credit wording?

maria_legal: I'll review by tomorrow noon. Note: avoid words like "guarantee" without exceptions; include scheduled maintenance and force majeure clauses.

Jon K (AM): If we finalize credit amount, include a one-off onboarding enablement session to lower renewal risk.

Ava C (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks team — Priya, Jon, Martin, Maria. I'll compile and share the draft in this thread.
